summary: This allows you to quickly view the currently assigned salary template (contract) for a specific employee directly from their employee master record.
steps: Click on the employee's record to view their details.
Scroll down to the bottom section of the employee details page.
Click on the 'Salary Template' section to expand and view the assigned contract details.
important_notes: While a 'New Add' option might be present here, it is generally recommended to use 'HRM > Assign Salary Template' for assigning new contracts, as it provides better calculation visibility and options.
This view is read-only for the contract details; to modify, you would typically go through 'Assign Salary Template' for future contracts or 'Salary Summary Month Wise' for current month adjustments.
questions: How can I check an employee's current salary contract?
Where do I find the assigned salary template for an employee?
Can I view an employee's contract details from their master record?
Is it possible to edit an employee's contract from their view page?
related_topics: Assigning Salary Template (Contract) to an Employee
